definitions.explanation: Containing unnecessary repetition or excess; using more words or elements than needed.

examples.japanese: {冗長|じょうちょう}な{文章|ぶんしょう}は{読|よ}みにくい。
examples.english: Verbose writing is hard to read.

examples.japanese: この{説明|せつめい}は{少|すこ}し{冗長|じょうちょう}だ。
examples.english: This explanation is a bit long-winded.

examples.japanese: {冗長性|じょうちょうせい}を{排除|はいじょ}して{文章|ぶんしょう}を{簡潔|かんけつ}にした。
examples.english: I removed the redundancy and made the text concise.

notes:
FORMS:
・{冗長|じょうちょう}な〜 (na-adjective modifier)
・{冗長|じょうちょう}に - verbosely
・{冗長性|じょうちょうせい} - redundancy (noun form)

TECHNICAL USE:
In computing, {冗長性|じょうちょうせい} (redundancy) can be positive, referring to backup systems that prevent data loss. {冗長|じょうちょう}{構成|こうせい} means "redundant configuration" for fault tolerance.

ANTONYM:
{簡潔|かんけつ} - concise, brief
